purpose: Stateful, spoiler-free acceptance sequences for the MATH 1920 sandbox. These are behavioral contracts; the existing single-turn run-fixtures.py does not execute them.
invariants: A player's direct, unambiguous, lawful action may commit without a prior Draft.
A reference to an old or ambiguous plan cannot silently select an arbitrary candidate.
A lesson-first request never commits the action before the lesson and renewed authorization.
Quiet mode persists across ordinary non-answer turns, without leaking steps.
Knowledge evidence must be verified, unconsumed, session-scoped and causally relevant to the specific action; correctness is separate from game success.
No sequence authorizes hidden-world disclosure or production state changes.

testHarnessNotes: Run only against isolated sandbox sessions and fake state; never real user saves.
Assert server commit and learning event tables, not only narration text.
For conditional outcomes, set deterministic game RNG and explicitly legal action fixtures.
Do not infer real model pass/fail from this specification; run fixtures before claiming success.
